title: The Second Flood: What Sumatra's Return to the Water Says About Recovery Risk
detail: A year after Cyclone Senyar killed more than 1,200 people, floods are back in Aceh Tamiang and Langkat while fewer than 4% of planned permanent homes are built and insurers carried under 2% of the last bill, leaving the state and the banks to absorb the next one.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
